hourly_cost_basis: User-specified assumption for 1x H100, not a verified current Together quote. The historical deployment screen showed $5.40/hour.
limitations: Extrapolates a short error-free load stage; not measured sustained maximum capacity.
Full utilization means this request rate is sustained while the endpoint is billed, not a measured GPU-utilization percentage.
Warm/reused short prompts may benefit from caching; max_tokens was 1 and logprobs were disabled.
Uses successful requests, not correct decisions: this load stage had 299 correct out of 388.
Combined-token equivalent includes input and output; independent input/output prices cannot be inferred from one workload.
Excludes training, other infrastructure, and potential failed-request/retry overhead.
Not applicable to the longer research-paper workload or a different checkpoint without measurement.
